defs.def: the coloured part of a plant from which the seed or fruit develops. Flowers usually grow at the end of a stem and last only a short time. 花；花朵

ex.s: It’s known for its flower festival.
How she is one of the experts, writing books on flower arrangement.
ex.t: 她本人就是专家之一，写过关于插花的书。

ex.s: Flowers are everywhere-hanging baskets, window boxes, and planters-just what you imagine in an attractive English market town.
ex.t: 鲜花无处不在——吊篮、窗台花箱和花盆里——正是你在一个迷人的英国集镇里所能想象的样子。

ex.s: I also water the flowers in the yard and tidying up my own bedroom whatever necessary.
ex.t: 我还给院子里的花浇水，并在必要时整理自己的卧室。

ex.s: Although Mary loved flowers,   62   she nor her husband was known as a gardener.
ex.t: 尽管玛丽喜欢花卉，____62____但她和她丈夫都不以园艺闻名。

ex.s: Mary’s sister, Frances Todd Wallace, often came over   63   （plant）flowers in the front yard.
ex.t: 玛丽的妹妹弗朗西斯·托德·华莱士经常过来在前院____63____（种）花。

ex.s: This is why decorating with plants, fruits and flowers ___62___ (carry) special significance.
ex.t: 这就是为什么用植物、水果和鲜花装饰____62____（具有）特殊意义的原因。

ex.s: Most kids want superheroes, sports team logos or princesses, while babies often receive scenes with flowers, trees and sea creatures.
ex.t: 大多数孩子想要超级英雄、运动队标志或公主图案，而婴儿常常收到印有花卉、树木和海洋生物的图案。

ex.s: I think of one friend who couldn't arrange flowers to satisfy herself.
ex.t: 我想起一位朋友，她怎么插花都无法让自己满意。

ex.s: This small group bike tour is a fantastic way to see a world-famous cherry trees with beautiful flowers of Washington, D.C.
ex.t: 这次小型团体自行车之旅是欣赏华盛顿特区举世闻名的樱树上美丽花朵的绝佳方式。

ex.s: Materials for making natural dyes can often be found in gardens 2 _____ colourful flowers are planted.
ex.t: 制作天然染料的材料通常可以在种了五颜六色鲜花的花园里找到。

ex.s: People prepare decorations with flowers and dance around maypoles.
ex.t: 人们用鲜花做装饰，围着五朔节花柱跳舞。

ex.s: Today, I gave my aunt some flowers and a scarf.
ex.t: 今天，我给了婶婶一些花和一条围巾。

ex.s: People celebrate the festival by climbing mountains, appreciating chrysanthemum flowers and drinking chrysanthemum wine.
ex.t: 人们通过登山、赏菊花和饮菊花酒来庆祝这个节日。

ex.s: The colours of the flowers range from bright yellows to brownish yellows, showing that the flowers are at different stages of life.
ex.t: 花的颜色从亮黄色到棕黄色不等，显示出花朵处于生命的不同阶段。

defs.def: a plant grown for the beauty of its flowers 开花植物
a flower with its stem that has been picked as a decoration （已摘）带梗的花
to produce flowers 花草树木
to develop and become successful 成熟；繁荣；兴旺
